title: UFOs come from whatever direction he looks

tellings.quote: We can turn in any direction and focus there and that's where it'll come from.

plain: During night skywatching, unexplained lights are said to arrive from whichever direction the group chooses to look. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts these objects, tells Michels this from his own experience: they can turn any way and focus there, and that is where the object comes from, which, if true, would suggest the lights respond to the watchers.
